@Test public void widevineOfflineReleasedLicenseV22() throws Throwable {
  if (Util.SDK_INT < 22 || Util.SDK_INT > 28 || GtsTestUtil.shouldSkipWidevineTest(testRule.getActivity())) {
    return;
  }
  try {
    downloadLicense();
    releaseLicense();
  } catch (NullPointerException | IllegalStateException e) {
    // 捕获开发阶段可能抛出的断言异常，避免中断测试流程
    throw new AssertionError("Unexpected runtime exception in license handling", e);
  }
  Throwable error = assertThrows("Playback should fail because the license has been released.", Throwable.class, () -> testRunner.run());
  Throwable cause = error.getCause();
  while (cause != null && cause != error) {
    error = cause;
    cause = error.getCause();
  }
  assertThat(error).isInstanceOf(MediaDrmStateException.class);
}
</最终结果>
